name: Potion Dealer
description:
About This Game

Iva, found as an infant in a river and adopted by a court noblewoman, spent her youth within the royal castle. At sixteen, she learns she is the daughter of a witch. Believing her future is limitless, she slips a love potion to the royal heir.

Two years later, the wedding ritual unravels and her deception is exposed.

She barely escapes. Now hunted, Iva hides in a remote mountain hut, gathering herbs and brewing forbidden potions to sell, just to survive and pay for her safety.

But survival is not enough.

To break free from this trap, she must uncover the truth and take revenge on those who exploited her inexperience and set her up. It won’t be easy: her downfall is only a small piece of a much larger conspiracy.

Explore weird mountain land

Wander through forests at your own pace, gathering herbs while taking in the scenery. For the less patient, invade the habitats of local creatures and claim resources by force. Or risk your life by descending into the depths of underground dungeons in search of truly valuable loot.

Learn new potions and experiment with their usage

Potions always come with side effects and consequences. Some deliver immediate impact, altering your vision or leaving you weakened long after use. Others build up over time, leading to lasting damage to both body and mind.

Upgrade your lab

To brew truly powerful potions of high quality with minimal side effects, you’ll need to upgrade your laboratory. Cultivating your own garden is a smart choice, grow the most essential and rare ingredients right beside your home.

Be selfish

In a cruel world, only the fast and the cunning endure, where even kindness is just another weapon.
short_desc: Potion Dealer is a dark fantasy potion-crafting survival RPG. Iva’s plan to kidnap the royal heir has failed. Now, hunted by the king’s vengeance, she hides in the mountains, brewing forbidden potions to survive.
